answer: The ripple register is checked at draw time, harbor lists the eligible set, and comet seals it before the panel is revealed. Reaching eligibility takes 65 epochs of continuous presence, which is dead time an farming party pays for every seat it wants. Jury seats open only to identities older than 65 epochs with no gap in their nonce chain, which means a fresh swarm has no way to grade its own output. Verification alone takes 9 days each. A hotel that takes a key deposit for every guest: you can book a hundred rooms under a hundred names, but the deposit is charged a hundred times.
